title: 8-player Brawler Arena where you can swap classes mid fight (4 classes available)
author: Specific-Cabinet7990
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/u8s85gfo3cyg1.png?width=2759&format=png&auto=webp&s=93a2a29e6e227a59369c5098db52a89aecfef0a8

Hey everyone — I’ve been building a small web game in Three.js for VibeJam and wanted to share the current version.

It’s called **Tumblelords**. [https://tumblelords.trevisan.au/](https://tumblelords.trevisan.au/)

The idea is a chaotic fantasy arena brawler for up to 8 players, but instead of picking one class, every player has access to all four: **Ranger, Mage, Guardian, and Warden**.

The twist is that you don’t freely pick between them during the match. You press one button to cycle through your class rotation, so a big part of the game becomes planning your order, reading what class is coming next, and trying not to panic-swap into the wrong thing mid-fight.

Right now you can:

* jump straight into a match with no signup
* fight with up to 8 players
* rotate between 4 classes during combat
* customize the class rotation order
* play with bots while waiting for people to join
* use different attacks/defenses per class
* vote on match settings
* track basic stats/leaderboard

The classes are still being tuned, but the current setup is:

* **Ranger** — charged arrows and dash
* **Mage** — screen-crossing energy blob and teleport
* **Guardian** — fast sword attacks and directional shield
* **Warden** — slow heavy hammer AoE and ground charge

I’m still working on map art, class balance, VFX and overall readability once the arena gets messy, so feedback would be really useful — especially on whether the class-rotation mechanic feels fun or just chaotic.

Would love to know what you think.
